generation_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one finished, distinctive logo for the Windows terminal application toiqtty. Brand context: fast, precise, native Windows terminal, split panes and persistent shells, developer focused; existing appearance uses Catppuccin Mocha with icy cyan #74C7EC and lavender #B4BEFE on deep charcoal. Asset: a polished horizontal brand lockup on a genuinely transparent background, suitable for a README header and product identity. On the left, create an original compact geometric monogram: a lowercase t and q suggested by a small number of thick, beautifully aligned angular strokes, with a terminal cursor or prompt suggested through clever negative space. Prioritize a strong recognizable silhouette that could work separately as a tiny app icon. Do not draw a terminal window or a generic >_ inside a rounded rectangle. To the right, exact lowercase wordmark 'toiqtty', spelled t-o-i-q-t-t-y, set in a refined custom geometric monospaced-inspired sans serif; exceptionally clean spacing, mature typography, readable q and y. Symbol in icy cyan with at most one small lavender detail; wordmark in pale cool white suitable for dark backgrounds. Flat vector-like rendering, precise crisp edges, generous intentional negative space, visually balanced scale between symbol and wordmark. No gradients, no glow, no shadows, no 3D, no extra text, no slogan, no mockups, no grids, no presentation sheets, no watermark. A single coherent logo only, centered with comfortable transparent margins. Transparent pixels must remain transparent, never draw a checkerboard.
refinement_prompt: Edit target: the supplied toiqtty logo. Preserve the cyan interlocked t-q monogram with its small lavender cursor detail and the exact lowercase wordmark 'toiqtty'. Refine this into a perfectly clean professional logo. Replace the transparent background with an absolutely uniform solid deep charcoal #181825 background. Every letter and every shape must have fully solid uniform fill with smooth precise antialiased edges: the wordmark solid pale #E8ECF4, monogram solid cyan #74C7EC, tiny cursor solid lavender #B4BEFE. Remove absolutely all speckles, grunge, holes, texture, stray fragments, outlines, gradients, noise, scratch marks and glow. The counters inside o and q remain background-colored but the solid letter strokes contain no holes or mottling. Rebalance the lockup with comfortable margins and slightly more space between mark and wordmark. Flat vector-style geometric brand identity, horizontal composition, a single finished logo, no extra text, no watermark, no mockup.
notes: New logo concept; existing application icon remains separate. The first transparent generation was discarded after edge-quality review.
